title: Gestor Comercial
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

A Ademicon é a maior administradora independente de consórcios do Brasil. Com mais de 30 anos de história e presença nacional e internacional, somos referência em inovação, solidez e geração de valor para pessoas e empresas que buscam construir patrimônio de forma inteligente. Oferecemos consórcios de imóveis, veículos leves, pesados e serviços, com condições flexíveis e soluções financeiras pensadas para atender diferentes projetos de vida e expansão de negócios.

Com mais de 80 bilhões em créditos ativos e milhares de clientes contemplados, entregamos uma experiência completa: desde o planejamento da compra até a realização do sonho ou investimento. Acreditamos que democratizar o acesso ao crédito e impulsionar o desenvolvimento local são pilares para transformar a vida de famílias e fortalecer empresas. Nossos diferenciais: Especialistas em consórcios de alta performance Atendimento consultivo e personalizado Soluções sob medida para pessoas físicas e jurídicas Gestão transparente e sólida Mais de 130 mil clientes ativos Ampliação de patrimônio sem juros bancários.

Buscamos Gestor Comercial com visão empreendedora e habilidade de relacionamento com clientes diversos (PF e PJ). O dia a dia envolve a gestão de equipes, atuação com vendas consultivas de produtos financeiros Consórcio de Carro, Imóveis e Serviços – com foco na construção de relacionamentos sólidos e de longo prazo, assim como a atração e capacitação de novos consultores.

Nosso propósito é trazer impacto financeiro positivo para famílias e negócios.

Trabalho preferencialmente presencial com flexibilidade de horário.

Principais atividades:

  • Gestão e treinamento constante da equipe de Vendas;
  • Atração e capacitação de novos consultores de Vendas;
  • Acompanhamento e desenvolvimento de consultores na jornada de vendas e processos administrativos da gestão de carteira de clientes;
  • Prospecção ativa de clientes potenciais (PF e PJ), venda de serviços financeiros, gestão de carteira de clientes e pós venda;
  • Agendamento e condução de reuniões com clientes potenciais englobando: identificação de necessidade, apresentação de soluções / produtos, simulação de cenários, negociação de propostas e fechamento de vendas;
  • Gestão do cliente no pós venda desde a gestão estratégica da carteira até os processos administrativos essenciais dos produtos adquiridos.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

Pré-Requisitos:

· Sólida experiência com gestão de equipes de vendas;

· Forte vivência na área comercial;

· Experiência com vendas de produtos financeiros será um plus;

· Alta ambição de carreira e visão empreendedora;

· Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal;

· Independência, autonomia com alto foco em resultados e performance;

· Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos de entrega de resultados.

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

O que oferecemos:

· Contrato PJ 100% comissionada sem limite de ganhos;

· Perspectiva de rendimentos acima da média do mercado;

· Escritório moderno e bem equipado para reuniões presenciais;

· Plano de carreira estruturado com perspectiva de ascensão rápida;

· Treinamento e capacitação técnica diferenciada com foco em alta performance.

Nossos Pilares:

PENSAMOS GRANDE: Nós nos desafiamos e sempre queremos ter mais da vida.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES: Fazemos o nosso sucesso, vestimos a camisa da empresa. Ademicon é nosso sobrenome.

MENTE ABERTA: Aceitamos mudanças e somos motivados por elas. Inovamos e fazemos de forma diferenciada.

CORRENTE DO BEM: Nossa essência e nossos resultados estão nas pessoas. Somos humanos.

The HR Analyst – Operations & Regulatory Training will provide operational HR support to the offshore workforce, ensuring compliance with regulatory training requirements, maintaining workforce readiness, and supporting crewing, certifications, and data management. Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree - Business Administration or other areas related

Experience

  • Previous experience with HR or similar positions
  • Experienced in dealing with confidential and sensitive information
  • Experience in oil and gas companies

Knowledge

  • Experience with employee management systems such as Workable, Cornerstone, Drake, IFS, or similar platforms
  • Knowledge of offshore operations and daily offshore routines
  • Familiarity with key HR functions, including recruitment, compensation, training, and performance management for offshore teams

Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

title: Manager, Budgets & AR Compliance
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Budgets & AR Compliance Manager supports the financial operations of Auxiliary Enterprises by coordinating annual budget development, monitoring spending, and ensuring accurate accounts receivable processing and compliance. This role assists with forecasting and financial reporting, maintains financial records and documentation, and collaborates with campus partners and vendors to support strong fiscal management and business operations across auxiliary units.

Supervisory Authority

May provide direction to support staff, student workers, or temporary personnel as assigned. Responsible for managing workload priorities, reviewing routine work outputs for accuracy, and supporting training related to budget and accounts receivable processes. Does not have full-time direct supervisory responsibility for permanent staff.

Nature And Scope

Reports to the Director of Operations & Finance. Internal contacts include Auxiliary Enterprises leadership and staff, University Budget Office, Accounts Receivable, Procurement, and other financial and administrative units. The position interacts with departments across campus regarding billing, budget processes, and financial documentation. External contacts include vendor representatives and auditors in support of billing, reconciliation, and reporting requirements.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Coordinate annual budget development for Auxiliary Enterprises and assist units in preparing budget submissions and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor department budgets throughout the year, prepare monthly budget-to-actual reports, and highlight variances for leadership review.
  • Maintain accounts receivable tracking and ensure timely and accurate billing, posting, reconciliation, and follow-up on outstanding balances.
  • Process journal entries, assist with month-end and year-end close activities, and support internal accounting requirements.
  • Track and maintain financial records, reporting schedules, and documentation in alignment with University accounting policies and audit standards.
  • Provide financial data, analysis, and supporting reports to leadership for planning and decision-making purposes.
  • Support requisition submission, invoice routing, and financial workflow approvals to ensure proper expense control and documentation.
  • Assist with internal and external audit requests, prepare supporting materials, and help implement process improvements to strengthen controls.
  • Serve as a point of contact for departments and vendors regarding billing, receivables, and budget-related inquiries.
  • Assist with system data entry, report creation, and spreadsheet management for budget, AR, and financial tracking functions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of budget monitoring, revenue tracking, and business operations across auxiliary units.

Core Competencies

  • Expertise in budget management, financial reporting, and compliance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret contracts and enforce compliance.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams, service providers, and complex budgets.
  • Ability to develop long-term strategies that balance financial sustainability with operational excellence.
  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills with focus on accountability and innovation.
  • Commitment to service quality, timeliness, and the University’s mission.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or related field with 3–5 years of progressive financial management experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$80,000 - $85,000

description:
Company Overview

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um pouco mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

Role Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in quality management, process auditing, Sales QA, especially in field sales, tech, or scaling environments.
  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, site/system usage tracking, and understanding of how systems impact commercial behavior.
  • Hands-on mindset and physical presence: comfortable conducting field visits, in-person assessments, and working closely with on-the-ground teams.
  • Strong communication skills, with assertiveness to raise operational gaps and collaborate across functions to solve them.
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, with proven results in bringing quality insights into actionable interventions (training, KB updates, process/system refinements).
  • Certifications like Six Sigma / Black Belt or Enablement experience are a plus.

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.
  • Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.
  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.
  • Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project
  • Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons
  • Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Senior Manager Uniforms

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Uniforms Senior Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for full project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
  • Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
  • Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
  • Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout
  • Develop the operational plan, setting up affiliated systems, identify functional distribution spaces, engage with stakeholders, contract local suppliers to deliver the FWWC2027 uniform programme, across all the Uniforms Distribution Centers
  • Oversee FIFA27 uniform budget, including creating accurate forecasts for each FIFA27 related event e.g. FWWC2027 Draw
  • Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations
  • Recruit and effectively train and manage the uniforms team (both workforce and volunteers) during planning and delivery periods ensuring best practices are clearly defined and the service level provided across all Uniform Distribution Centers is consistent
  • Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
  • Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event
  • Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
  • Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw
  • Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms
  • Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations.

Your Profile

Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum experience of 3 years in Uniform Management; preferably with experience in mega (sports) events and corporate organisations
  • Excellent people manager, motivating, inspiring and seeing results through others
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong IT skill including MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint)
  • Strong written and oral communication
  • Proven track record in administering uniform projects across complex quantity structures
  • Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence, with a pragmatic approach to solving problems
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to balance competing priorities
  • Demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Overview

Customer support has become a battlefield of rising complexity and escalating expectations. Today's customers demand AI-driven, immediate solutions, yet most companies remain stuck in experimental phases, unable to transform AI into tangible results. The challenge is about to intensify. Industry forecasts suggest that by 2029, agentic systems will handle the majority of routine issues autonomously, creating a widening chasm between what customers expect and what organizations can deliver today. Our approach bridges this divide through a distinct framework: AI-enhanced “cyborg” support specialists who combine sophisticated diagnostic expertise with product knowledge and agentic AI capabilities. In this position, you refine, repair, and mentor the technology. Each resolution strengthens our automation frameworks, every root cause investigation becomes a repeatable solution pattern, and every complex scenario you decode enhances system performance for thousands of future customers. This role sits at the intersection of advanced diagnostics, human judgment, and AI coordination to deliver superior resolutions now while building compounding intelligence for the future.

This position demands hands-on technical problem-solving at production scale. You will investigate ambiguous failures spanning networks, databases, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise applications; harness AI to formulate hypotheses, validate theories, and accelerate resolution; capture the human reasoning that trains our systems; and proactively identify patterns that convert one-time fixes into lasting automation. This is not about following scripts, sorting tickets, or escalating to senior engineers. If you excel at creative problem-solving when documentation is sparse, if you can pivot seamlessly from packet analysis to execution plans to workflow traces, and if you\'re confident challenging an LLM\'s conclusions, this role will suit you well.

Responsibilities

  • AI-Enhanced Customer Problem Resolution: Investigate complex support cases escalated from AI systems, apply human judgment where AI capabilities are limited, and subsequently enhance the AI system to narrow those gaps

  • Spending two full months onboarding; you will need to achieve proficiency across multiple products within your first month (we recognize this timeline is demanding)
  • Depending on management for assistance; if you cannot effectively remove your own obstacles, this role will present significant challenges

Engenheiro De Suporte Técnico Key Responsibilities

  • Combine technical human judgment with AI tools to provide outstanding customer support, concentrating on sophisticated problems that AI cannot yet independently address

Basic Requirements

  • Must be located in North or South America
  • Minimum of 3 years total experience in technical customer support positions
  • Fundamental coding abilities for troubleshooting and bug resolution purposes
  • Diagnostic Capabilities: Translating technical complexity into accessible explanations, exhibiting thorough problem comprehension, identifying appropriate troubleshooting approaches, presenting multiple resolution options, and maintaining meticulous attention to detail

About Trilogy

Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, Innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses. Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today\'s modern cloud-based stack. Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career by leaps and bounds.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

Working with us

The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

As an integral part of the Department of Dermatology, the Administrative Coordinator provides a range of administrative support to the Department Chair and multiple faculty in the Department of Dermatology at Howard University. Responsibilities include assisting with daily administrative operations, coordinating and scheduling complex appointments and meetings, coordinating travel and preparing associated materials, preparing correspondence, compiling data, coordinating special projects and events, and records maintenance. This position will be responsible for monitoring departmental academic and research budgets and business affairs, personnel matters and interpreting policy and procedures. The position will perform duties of a sensitive and confidential nature. Incumbents typically work at a high degree of independence with general direction and supervision received from the Department Chair.

Supervisory Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training other administrative hires, as needed in the future. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over clerical positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks.

Nature And Scope

The principal duties and responsibilities of the Administrative Coordinator include, but are not limited to: Compose and prepare correspondence as well as assist in writing and preparation of manuscripts, grants, questionnaires, journal reviews, presentations, reports, letters, and memos for the Chair’s review and signature. Read email and coordinate office communications ensuring timeliness and accuracy. Screen and provide telephone coverage for the Chair, Faculty, and administrative offices. Represent the Chair in meetings, take dictation, minutes, notes and prepare final copy for review and arrange department meetings. Create graphic brochures, posters, signs, labels for conferences, newsletters, invitations and presentation slides for the department. Assist the Chair with activities relating to the University/College of Medicine, the Faculty Practice Plan (FPP), and the Hospital (HUH) (see below). Assist the Chair in the preparation of all faculty appointment, promotion and tenure applications and performance evaluations (e.g. OPPE). Assist with departmental development/philanthropic projects and continuing medical education (CME) conferences.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist and submit Attending Physicians OPPE and FPPE.
  • Coordinate Attending Physicians and staff work requests for facility maintenance or housekeeping.
  • Coordinate CME activities and other events.
  • Coordinate Department Events, on and off-campus.
  • Prepare annual and operational reports for the Chair’s approval.
  • Prepare and compile department appointment/re-appointment/promotion/tenure documents.
  • Honors & Oath (medical school graduation) ceremony: order regalia, order plaque and submit check request for dermatology prize recipient.
  • Assist faculty with grant applications.
  • Prepare and submit expense vouchers, arrange travel schedules.
  • Submit Attending Physicians leave slips.
  • Submit Attending Physician Clinic schedule changes.
  • Prepare and assist with the development of department budget and proposals.
  • Prepare and submit external and internal letters, memos and/or forms for Attending Physicians.
  • Facilitate Attending Physicians and staff computer, printer issues.
  • Maintain Attending Physicians on-call schedule.
  • Order Dermatology office supplies / furniture.
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracts for hardware, software, equipment and services.
  • Coordination of purchase and maintenance of departmental equipment and licensing agreements.
  • Manage overall department appearance: painting, seasonal decorations.
  • Coordinate departmental fundraiser(s) and annual alumni donation campaign.
  • Maintain accurate alumni contact list.
  • Coordinate physician attendance at community health fairs.
  • Create and disseminate quarterly departmental alumni newsletter.
  • Maintain and distribute Attending Physicians license and malpractice insurance status.
  • Facilitate hiring and on boarding of new faculty.
  • Schedule meetings for Chair and faculty.
  • Support and represents the Chair at meetings in her absence.
  • Assist with maintenance of departmental PR initiatives and social media platforms.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Ability to operate a fax, copier, scanner, telephone, computer.
  • Skill in typing and the operation of computers, related software applications (e.g. Microsoft Suite, Zoom etc.).
  • Knowledge and skill in managing websites and professional social media content.
  • Ability to problem solve and make decisions.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in office technology and software to ensure efficient office practices.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (a writing sample may be requested after the interview).
  • Strong organizational skills, flexibility, motivation, ability to multitask.
  • The ability to work independently, establish and maintain effective harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

High School diploma or equivalent and at least 5 years of related work experience. BA/BS may be substituted for up to 2 years related work experience.

Atividades

  • Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas específicas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente.
  • Conferir e repor o carro e maleta de PCR, após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações.
  • Fazer conferência mensal dos materiais permanentes e consignados (VALIDADE).
  • Contactar equipe médica e anestesistas sobre procedimentos eletivos e emergências.
  • Preparar sala e mesas para exames e/ou cirurgias.
  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os médicos nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: Cateterismo Cardíaco, Angioplastia (coronariana e vascular), Arteriografias (cerebral, renal, pulmonar, medular, mesentérica, MMII e MMSS, Drenagem Biliar, Colocação de Filtro de Veia Cava e PICC, Embolização Cerebral, Quimoembolização (hepáticas, uterinas e mesentéricas), Estudo Eletrofisiológico + Ablação, Aortografia.
  • Utilizar EPIs específicos: capote de chumbo, protetor de tireoide, óculos plumbífero, dosímetro, (sala de Hemodinâmica chumbada com aparelho de intensificador de Raio X).
  • Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.
  • Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade em sala, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu exame.
  • Confirmar e checar JEJUM, ALERGIA, especificamente à IÔDO com o paciente.
  • Receber e preparar o paciente na sala de Hemodinâmica:
  • Identificação do paciente no livro de sala com número de exame, médico que realizará o procedimento, horários de início e término;
  • Cuidados de enfermagem: posicionamento do paciente na mesa de exame, monitorização (Sapo², F.C, F.R, PNI, PAM, Temperatura., CO₂), punção venosa periférica, sondagem vesical, aspiração orotraqueal, oxigenioterapia, administração de medicamentos, assepsia e antissepsia.
  • Cobrança de folha dos materiais utilizados em sala durante os exames.

Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seus cuidados em sala, registrando na evolução qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.

Outras Informações

  • Local de trabalho: Freguesia(Jacarepaguá) , Rio de Janeiro.
  • Escala de trabalho: À combinar.
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento de 30 dias como diarista.

title: Cloud Professional Services Manager
description:
Overview

This is an opportunity to run a Professional Services team (also known as Field Engineering) team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team\'s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.

We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of \'most software to most companies\'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.

The role of a Cloud Professional Services Manager at Canonical

The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.

A Cloud Professional Services Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.

Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Equal opportunity

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Senior Account Manager / Account Director !

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.
  • Note: If you're hired for this role, you may be asked to update your LinkedIn profile :)

About The Role

We are a fast-growing, highly specialized digital marketing agency serving dental practices across the United States. Our clients invest seriously in marketing and expect clarity, confidence, and results — especially when challenges arise.We are hiring a Senior Account Manager / Account Director to strengthen our senior client leadership layer. This role exists to provide calm, structure, and decisive ownership across complex accounts, and to act as a trusted escalation point when issues exceed day-to-day account management.This is a senior, judgment-heavy role. The right person has already handled demanding clients, managed internal complexity, and taken responsibility for fixing problems — not just reporting on them.Depending on experience and demonstrated capability, this role may operate closer to a Senior Account Manager or a full Account Director level.

What You’ll Own

Senior Client Leadership & Escalation

  • Act as a primary escalation point for complex or sensitive client issues
  • Lead difficult conversations with confidence and emotional intelligence
  • Reset expectations, de-escalate tension, and reestablish trust when needed
  • Proactively identify accounts at risk and intervene before problems escalate

Account Oversight & Organization

  • Oversee a portfolio of accounts with a focus on organization, follow-through, and accountability
  • Ensure client requests, deliverables, and internal actions are clearly tracked and prioritized
  • Coordinate across Paid Media, SEO, Tracking, and Operations teams to resolve blockers
  • Bring structure to ambiguity and order to fast-moving situations

Strategic Communication (Not Channel Execution)

  • Understand campaign performance well enough to speak credibly and clearly with clients
  • Translate technical or operational issues into plain, confident client-facing explanations
  • Help clients understand why something is happening and what the plan is to fix it
  • Identify opportunities to expand or deepen relationships when appropriate

Internal Leadership & Judgment

  • Know when to escalate — and when not to
  • Make sound judgment calls without waiting for constant approval
  • Support and guide junior AMs through complex situations
  • Surface recurring issues and help improve internal processes over time

Leveling & Scope Expectations

We are open to hiring at different points within this senior range, based on experience and demonstrated ownership:

Senior Account Manager–Level Candidates

  • Independently manage complex accounts with minimal oversight
  • Confidently handle escalations but may involve leadership for higher-risk situations
  • Strong organizers and communicators who bring consistency and reliability

Account Director–Level Candidates

  • Operate as a true stabilizing force across high-value or high-risk accounts
  • Own escalations end-to-end with little to no leadership involvement
  • Trusted to make judgment calls that protect retention and long-term relationships
  • Naturally operate as a mentor and senior presence within the AM team

Compensation within the range reflects where a candidate operates across this spectrum.

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

  • 5–8+ years in a senior Account Manager or Account Director role at a digital marketing agency
  • Direct experience managing U.S.-based clients
  • Proven ownership of escalations, renewals, and retention
  • Comfort working across Paid Media, SEO, and performance marketing environments
  • Experience coordinating multiple internal teams simultaneously

Communication & Presence

  • Near-perfect spoken and written English (non-negotiable)
  • Confident, composed presence on Zoom and client calls
  • Able to push back diplomatically and set boundaries when needed
  • Trusted quickly by senior decision-makers

Personal Traits

  • Highly organized; systems-oriented, not reactive
  • Calm under pressure; emotionally mature
  • Naturally proactive — sees issues before they explode
  • Takes ownership rather than deferring responsibility
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, evolving environment

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

title: Legacy Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your profile

  • Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations: Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Partnership Development Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The position

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Job Summary

Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

We are looking for curious, analytical, and forward-thinking problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien as part of our Tech Talent Program 2026 in a full-time position.

In this role, you will apply your knowledge of physics, mathematics, and technology to solve challenges across energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside industry experts, you will contribute to cutting-edge projects that redefine how we explore and understand the Earth’s subsurface.

To support your success, we provide structured onboarding, comprehensive technical training, and ongoing mentorship. You will learn how to transform raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D subsurface models, generating insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental stewardship.

In This Role, You Will

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to tackle complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and improve algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Work closely with Research and Software Development teams to help shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and support innovation across the organization and the wider geophysical community.

About The Team

You will join a supportive and collaborative team working on real-world geophysical challenges.

Our culture is driven by science, sparked by collaboration, and propelled by ambition — pillars that reflect what makes working at Viridien unique and exciting. They shape how we learn from each other, tackle complex problems, and grow together in an environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and continuous development from day one.

Qualifications

  • A PhD or Master’s degree in Geophysics, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
  • A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a genuine interest in innovation and continuous learning.

Benefits

At Viridien, we support both your professional growth and personal well-being:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private pension plan.

  • Hybrid work model (up to 2 remote days per week).
  • Birthday day off.
  • Christmas gift card.
  • Educational assistance and language learning programs.
  • Continuous development through our Learning Hub, offering both technical and behavioral training.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

Job Description

The position

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.
  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.
  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.
  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.
  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.
  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)
  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship
  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location

Location: Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train-the-Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master\'s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.

  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.

  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
